name: hgi_seq_fe-s4-COMMIT
purpose: FE child of the hgi_seq split: fetch FIFO, 64 KB ring, reader, lazy FIFO, parser, loops, image address; ~4.65k flops + 2 macro clock pins on its own root. Ring macros RE-PLACED (not the v26s place.tcl): R0 at x 22.464, y 23.76 / 116.64, >= 20 um to every core edge, 22.4 um channel, halo 5.4 um, temporary M5 keepout over the macro pin-edge bands (macro_edge_m5_guard: the v26s DRC was an M4 spacing short at the u_ring1 pin edge, a VIA45 dropped next to a 24 nm M4 pin stub)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_seq_fe #(.USE_MACRO(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS -Irtl/hbm_accel/generic --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/ot_hgi_seq_fe.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/ot_hgi_seq_hd.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hgi_seq_fe/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hgi_seq_fe/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hgi_seq_fe --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_seq_fe --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: hgi_seq flat (25,081 sinks on one root; v25s/v26s/v27a/v27b all failed FF hold on short reg->reg hops across spine leaves) is replaced by three hardened children with their own clock roots and reset synchronisers under a wires-only parent: five registered valid/credit seams, queue-full -> FE credit counter, injector stall -> registered hold; s2 (s1 983266320 NEEDS_RTL TT -59.64 on 28 endpoints, all be_jl_kernel_r -> kern_off, FF +15.24, DRC 0; every other class met 770 ps): the job-load kernel offset is computed in two edges (kernel-table select registered, then zero test / 32-b add), inside the unchanged SEAM_JL_WAIT 6 (it had one spare edge; lockstep gate PASS at 6 and FAIL at 5, so the closed BE view is unchanged; CP.FETCH 30,340 cycles = 0.953x of price); s3 (s2 031099211 NEEDS_RTL TT -55.21 on 50 endpoints, all g_ring rb_qq -> bank select x 256 -> word select -> FIFO entry select -> fqv, 14-15 levels launched 106 ps late beside the ring macros; FF -8.88 on md_k -> md_k_r): the selected ring sector is registered once more before the word FIFO (read pipe 3 -> 4 edges; the reader is credit-based, lockstep gate PASS, CP.FETCH 30,341 cycles = 0.953x); s4 (s3 2d9d65aad CLOSED TT +61.64 / FF +20.32 / DRC 0, but its view fails the die clock rule: o 409.8 ps (fe_s1_idx) + s 342.5 ps (f_req_rdy) = 752.3 > 683.3, boundary clock spread 105.2 ps > 80, 121 output bits launched > 220 ps after the boundary clock; of the 74 seam buses between the three die-placed leaves 4 (36 bits, fe_s1_idx / fe_s1_dmul / fe_s1_dsel -> AU, be_jl_entry -> FE) miss o + 0.76 L + s <= 623.3 ps by 2-49 ps because the placer-ordered pins put 136-183 um between tiles 4.3 / 10.8 um apart): FE pins by io_tcl on the tracks of the closed AU S-face and BE W-face pins, and the leaf clock on the pre-placed balanced spine (two ring SRAMs their own leaves) instead of TritonCTS; RTL, outline, faces, cycles and benches unchanged

reroute_reason.fix: every FE seam pin on the track of the closed AU / BE pin it meets (io_tcl: 759 pins, seam hops 58-222 um -> 4.3 / 10.8 um, 63 um for the 87 BE pins above the FE top edge), pin flops at those pins, and the boundary registers on a balanced clock spine (boundary spread 105.2 ps > 80 in the s3 view)
